name: Daphrena
subtitle: The Ancient World
body: Darphena lies far to the west, rugged and ancient. Among its great peaks and deep caverns, the Ancient Dwarves—a lineage untouched by time—still dwell. Many dwarves believe, without tangible proof, that their race was forged in Darphena’s mountains, born of stone and memory.

name: Maltona
subtitle: The Boundless Vale
body:
The greatest of the four continents, Maltona is the heart of the known world. Often called The Boundless Vale, it is a land of breathtaking beauty and brutal challenge. Some say the first sentient beings walked here, and even now, its soil holds ancient power. Kingdoms have risen and fallen vying for control of Maltona’s secrets, its riches, and its legacy. It remains, as ever, a land of promise, peril, and possibility.

Explore the Boundless Vale, discover its history, its scars andthe people who call it home, just with [a simple click](continent.html?id=maltona).

name: Eldenna
subtitle: The Torn Lands
body: To the north, where the sea and sky blur into mist, rises Eldenna. Some call it a continent, others an island. Elven legend holds that this was their first home in Eraldom, arriving from the shattered realm of Ydalheim when it collided with the Material Plane in ages long forgotten.

name: Verdena
subtitle: The Shun Lands
body: Shrouded in secrecy and dread, Verdena is known as the Shun Lands. It is spoken of in hushed tones, wrapped in myths of horrors that defy mortal understanding. Few have traveled there—and fewer have returned.
